name: Wadi Rum
bestView: From a camel or 4x4 at Um Frouth rock bridge 30 minutes before sunset, when the sand goes red
bestMonths: March to May, September to November. Summer passes 40°C
crowd: Tours bunch at the big rock bridges 16:00 to 18:00. Camp overnight: after 19:00 the desert is yours
kid: Bedouin camps, camel rides, scramble-proof sand dunes, and a night sky with zero light pollution. Kids sleep in the desert.
priceNote: Jordan is fair value. Agree the jeep tour price BEFORE getting in; anything quoted per person over $40 is tourist-priced.

visa.note: Visa on arrival for most nationalities (~40 JOD); free with Jordan Pass bought before arrival.
